What it solves: First-hand, not reported. Every fact in the description was read directly
from this checkout at the time of the strand - the marker file and its mtime,
the parcel filename with its dequeued_at, the refusal text, and
rotate-gate-decision's source. The memory lesson about re-running a peer's
claim do…
Approval context: Wants sign-off on two things.
Severity high. Nothing is down and no data is lost - one SWARMFORGE_ROTATE_FORCE=1 or a manual respawn clears it, and the stranded parcel is recoverable in full. I filed high rather than medium because it is a live fault that does not self-clear and it defeats a recove…
